answer: Bind voting rank to lifetime protocol fees burned by one key, turning steady tenure into a rare oasis new shell accounts cannot mimic. Users lock 48 POA, submit a burn hash plus receipt proof across >=16 epochs, and clear peer audit checks inside 60 minutes up a seniority trellis. Spoofed rings below <93% consensus suffer deposit forfeit, steep slash penalties, and <2% reward. Each honest peer burns 48 POA; 130 fake accounts cost 6240 POA to capture 62 POA, a harsh net loss dry as a walnut. Caveat: rich buyers can buy aged keys.
